title: LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2610.16782v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industrial manipulation in flexible manufacturing, e.g., high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) electronics assembly, requires robot policies to adapt to changing products and production conditions. Such settings impose industrial process constraints, including product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances. However, existing evaluation frameworks do not systematically capture these constraints when assessing generalist robot policies. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Industry, a novel benchmark built on the widely used robot learning benchmark LIBERO, that translates the aforementioned industrial constraints into controllable task conditions and measurable success criteria. Specifically, LIBERO-Industry comprises three classic task scenarios: Static-to-Dynamic (S2D) loading, Dynamic-to-Static (D2S) unloading, and Dynamic-to-Dynamic (D2D) transfer. translated_title: LIBERO-Industry：工业流程约束下的机器人操作基准测试
translated_abstract: 柔性制造中的工业操作，例如多品种、小批量（HMLV）电子产品装配，要求机器人策略能够适应不断变化的产品和生产条件。这类场景带来了工业流程约束，包括产品变体、移动的物料流、有限的执行时间窗口以及严格的几何公差。然而，现有的评估框架在评估通用机器人策略时并未系统地捕捉这些约束。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了LIBERO-Industry，这是一个基于广泛使用的机器人学习基准LIBERO构建的新型基准，它将上述工业约束转化为可控的任务条件和可度量的成功标准。具体而言，LIBERO-Industry包含三种经典任务场景：静态到动态（S2D）上料、动态到静态（D2S）下料以及动态到动态（D2D）搬运。该测试套件总共包含216个任务，
tldr: 该论文提出了LIBERO-Industry基准，首次将产品变体、移动物料流、有限执行窗口和严格几何公差等工业流程约束系统地转化为可控任务条件，涵盖S2D、D2S、D2D三类场景共216个任务，以更真实地评估通用机器人操作策略。
en_tdlr: LIBERO-Industry is a novel benchmark built on LIBERO that systematically translates industrial process constraints—product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances—into controllable task conditions across 216 tasks in three scenarios (S2D, D2S, and D2D), enabling more realistic evaluation of generalist robot manipulation policies.
